name: Classify Position Source
description: Classify records where position_source is ads_b

name: Classify Sensor Platform
description: Classify records where sensor_platform is GS-RADAR-01

name: Classify Origin Country
description: Classify records where origin_country is Austria

name: Classify Unidentified Flag
description: Classify a track as Unidentified when it is not Identified.

name: Classify Emergency Flag
description: Classify a track as Emergency when emergency_squawk is set or iff_mode equals emergency.

name: Classify Identified Flag
description: Classify a track as Identified when it correlates to a flight plan and iff_mode is mode3_valid.

name: Classify Kinematic Flag
description: Classify a track as KinematicallyImplausible when ground speed >= 600 knots and barometric altitude <= 2000 ft, or vertical rate >= 8000 fpm.

name: Classify Zone Breach Flag
description: Classify a track as ZoneBreach when it is inside a restricted operating zone and not corridor‑compliant.

name: Check Emergency Flag Equals Value
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when AirTrack.emergency_flag eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Decide escalate when AirTrack.emergency_flag
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when AirTrack.emergency_flag eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Check Zone Breach Flag Equals Value
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when AirTrack.zone_breach_flag eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Flag Emergency Flag Equals Value
description: Escalate any track classified as Emergency to a human operator.

name: Flag Unidentified Flag Equals Value
description: Monitor tracks that are Unidentified and have no response or invalid IFF mode.

name: Flag Zone Breach Flag Equals Value
description: Escalate any track classified as ZoneBreach to a human operator.

name: Check Kinematic Flag Equals Value
description: Reach the 'monitor' decision when AirTrack.kinematic_flag eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Check Unidentified Flag Equals Value
description: Reach the 'monitor' decision when AirTrack.unidentified_flag eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Check Unidentified Flag Equals Value (2)
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when any of the OR groups over [AirTrack.unidentified_flag, iff_mode] hold (synthesized from the policy's decision list).
